feature.federation.description: Pair with other BananaWiki installations and share pages read only.
feature.federation.name: Federation
federation.admin.disconnect_confirm: Delete this pairing, its outgoing shares and the copies received from it?
federation.admin.intro: Both administrators add the other wiki's ID and HTTPS address with the same newly generated pairing key, exchanged privately. Pairing alone shares no pages.
federation.admin.private: The other wiki is on a private network
federation.admin.private_hint: Allows private and loopback addresses for this peer. Leave off for wikis on the internet.
federation.admin.rotate: To change a key, address or audience, disconnect and pair again on both sides. The other wiki may keep what it already received.
federation.admin.secret_hint: Send this key to the other administrator over a channel you trust.
federation.admin.title: Paired wikis
federation.copy.as_text: The Markdown source is shown as text; nothing from the other wiki is executed or loaded.
federation.copy.delayed: Synchronisation is delayed; this copy may be out of date.
federation.copy.fork_hint: A fork becomes an independent, editable page in the pairing's audience category. Review it before publishing.
federation.copy.remote_login: The original may require signing in there.
federation.error.already_paired: That wiki, address or key is already paired. Disconnect it first.
federation.error.authentication: The other wiki refused the signature. Check the pairing key and both clocks.
federation.error.base_url: Use an HTTPS address without credentials, path or query.
federation.error.blocked_address: The address resolves to a private network, which this pairing does not allow.
federation.error.category: The audience category does not exist.
federation.error.fork_needs_category: Give the pairing an audience category before forking its pages.
federation.error.name: Choose a name and a wiki other than this one.
federation.error.network: The other wiki could not be reached.
federation.error.not_shareable: Share only an active Markdown page you may edit.
federation.error.peer_limit: The pairing limit has been reached.
federation.error.private_network_managed: Addresses on the local network cannot be used on a hosted wiki.
federation.error.remote_status: The other wiki refused the request. Check that it paired with this wiki.
federation.error.response_signature: The other wiki's answer was not signed with the pairing key.
federation.error.secret: Use a newly generated 64-character hexadecimal pairing key.
federation.error.secret_unreadable: The pairing key cannot be read (the instance key changed). Pair again.
federation.error.share_limit: This wiki's shared-page limit has been reached.
federation.error.snapshot: The other wiki sent an invalid snapshot.
federation.error.sync_failed: Synchronisation failed; check the pairing, clocks, network and the other wiki.
federation.error.too_large: Shared pages are limited to 128 KiB and titles to 300 characters.
federation.error.wiki_id: Use the wiki ID shown on the other wiki's federation page.
federation.flash.disconnected: Pairing, shares and received copies deleted.
federation.flash.not_synced: No synchronisation completed. Check the status below.
federation.flash.paired: Wiki paired. Synchronisation starts once both administrators have added the pairing.
federation.flash.shared: Page shared. Its future edits are sent until you withdraw the share.
federation.index.intro: Read-only copies from paired wikis. A copy disappears after 48 hours without a successful synchronisation.
federation.index.none: No received pages are available to you.
federation.index.title: Federated pages
federation.sharing.intro: Sharing sends a Markdown page and its future edits to a paired wiki, whose administrator decides who can read it. Attachments, history and builder pages are not sent. Withdrawing a share cannot erase copies already received.
federation.sharing.title: Share pages
